Plugin.Name: Unraid Rsync
Plugin.Overview: A native Unraid 7.x plugin that schedules and monitors multiple rsync backup jobs over SSH, to an rsync daemon (rsyncd), or locally between two paths on the server. Optional snapshot mode keeps dated, hard-linked versioned backups with retention.
Plugin.Description:
Unraid Rsync schedules and monitors multiple independent rsync backup jobs, each with its own cron schedule (or manual-only), source->destination pairs and rsync options.
Features: three transports (SSH push or pull, rsync daemon modules on a NAS, local paths under /mnt); reusable SSH connections with existing-key-file, managed-key or password auth (nothing extra to install); a whitelisted rsync option set with inline help and guardrails for destructive flags; an optional target marker so nothing is written to an unmounted drive; pre/post hooks with timeouts; live status badges, a per-run log viewer with full-log download, History across all jobs, an Overview tab and a Dashboard widget.
Snapshot mode (SSH push): every run writes a dated copy on the receiver, unchanged files are hard links to the previous one, and only runs that finished cleanly count. Daily, weekly and monthly retention with careful pruning (a prune dry run first, a per-run deletion limit, pins), a suspect-run hold that stops all deletions when a run looks wrong (far fewer files, runaway growth), and backup of the Unraid flash drive (/boot).
Notifications through Unraid's own system, with importance by cause (alert, warning, normal), plus crash detection for runs cut off by a crash or reboot.
Support: the Unraid forum thread https://forums.unraid.net/topic/199541-plugin-unraid-rsync-multi-job-rsync-backup-scheduler/ or GitHub issues https://github.com/sasa-fajkovic/unraid-rsync/issues
